### get picnic task
```{r}
raw_pi_data<- tbl(con,"visits_nlp_tier1") %>% 
  select(contains(c('Tpi')), visit_id) %>% 
  collect
```

### get pi assessments
```{r}
tbl_pi_raw <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select( visit_id, starts_with("picnic")) %>% #, contains(c("grandftr_status"," grandftr_com", "")) 
  collect

tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select( visit_id,  race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
```

### clean up demo

```{r}
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age))
```


### rm fully empty fields 
```{r}
cleaned_pi <- raw_pi_data %>% 
  select(visit_id, contains(c( "coherence")) ) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(contains('Tpi'), is.na))
```

### constrained to only comparing the different large langauage models and crampingtexs based on mean_coherence_sentence
```{r}
contrained_pi <- cleaned_pi %>% 
  select(
         contains(c("nlp_mean_coherence_sentence", "visit_id")),
         -contains(c('intrawindow_coherence', "Ss1", "Ss2", "Ss0")) ) %>% #, "Ss1", "Ss2"
  filter_out(if_all(contains('Tpi'), is.na))
```

```{r}
contrained_more_pi <- contrained_pi %>% 
  select(contains(c("CmaRnoAorMbiPauIidNorGag", "visit"))) %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(contains('Tpi'), is.na))
```

```{r}
pi_cols <- data.frame(colSums(is.na(contrained_pi)))
```

### combine cols
```{r}

###combining tables 

pi_total <- inner_join(contrained_more_pi, demographics, by = "visit_id")%>% 
  select(-c(diagnosis, medicaid)) %>% 
  mutate( 
    health_status := factor( case_when(
      further_diag == "HC" ~ "HC",
      further_diag =="AD" ~ "AD",
      .default = "other cases"),
      levels = c("HC", "AD", "other cases" ))
)
```


### demographics
```{r}
no_id <- pi_total %>% 
  select(-c(visit_id,visit_date, num_diagnosis, new_id,  shape, shape_num)) 
  
```

```{r}
table_1 <- tbl_summary(
  no_id,
  by = health_status,
  type = list(where(is.numeric) ~ "continuous"),
  list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
  label = c(list(race = "Race"), 
            list(eth = "Ethnicity"), 
            list(age_group = "Age"), 
            list(gender = "Gender"), 
            list(medicaid = "Medicaid")),
  missing_text = "Missing Values") %>% 
  as_gt()

table_1
```

```{r}
gt::gtsave(table_1, filename = "pi_demo.html")
```
